contract_before.target: Implement FIFO exactly; do not guarantee fewer deadline breaches

contract_after.rule: Prioritize deadline risk and scarce qualified reviewers rather than arrival order
contract_after.target: Reduce missed deadlines without increasing planned or actual reviewer hours

human_approval.override_rationale: R0のFIFO実装は独立評価でPASS。ODAの診断はHOLDのまま残し、理由・証拠・実装認識を個別に確認する。模擬反例と固定R1契約に基づく技術検証のみ継続し、実顧客の事業妥当性は未検証として扱う。

evidence.observation: 架空のClaims Operations Manager: FIFOでは期限の長い高額案件が先に処理され、後着の短納期案件が期限超過する。総稼働時間を増やさず期限超過件数を減らしたい。

case_discrimination.advisory: If no cases distinguish candidates, fixed-order selection is only reproducible, not evidence of superior generalization. Never move 08f cases back into DEV.

robustness_audit.policy: Gate first. Rank eligible candidates by DEV missed, DEV unassigned, then extra DEV cohort worst missed, total missed, total unassigned, then pinned stress worst missed, total missed, total unassigned, stable order. Incomplete cohorts are excluded equally across candidates.
robustness_audit.limitations: Four additional synthetic DEV cases plus four fixed stress cases; leave-one-out is sensitivity, NOT statistical confidence or real-world generalization. DEV case scoring is not a production SLA guarantee.

dev_selection_rationale.tie_rule: DEV missed, DEV unassigned, extra DEV cohort worst/total, pinned stress worst/total, stable source order last.
dev_selection_rationale.primary: DEV aggregate missed deadlines; lower is better
dev_selection_rationale.secondary: DEV unassigned cases; lower is better
dev_selection_rationale.scope: Predeclared synthetic DEV + four additional development shifts + four pinned stress scenarios; no 08f leakage or real-customer guarantees.
